description: This file contains test cases for tailnet helper functions, including network address detection, listing tailnet addresses, and picking primary addresses. It uses Vitest testing framework and mocks network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the given IP address is within the tailnet IPv4 range.

methods.name: listTailnetAddresses
methods.description: Lists all non-internal tailnet IPv4 and IPv6 addresses currently available.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects the first available IPv4 tailnet address.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv6
methods.description: Selects the first available IPv6 tailnet address.
